title: Long AMZN — AWS 37% Earnings Upcycle: Fastest Growth in 18 Quarters, AI Run Rate Confirmed
entry: Long AMZN $258–272 on July 31. The prior long-AMZN defensive thesis (entered at $232 in July, closed at T1 $260 today) established the cloud leadership. This is a NEW entry at a new price level, based on confirmed earnings inflection rather than thesis hypothesis. The entry zone covers: (1) any ECI-hot intraday dip toward $258–262 as the 30Y spikes and Nasdaq pulls back from the opening gap; (2) gap-stabilization at $265–272 if the pre-market $268 holds as the session floor. Do NOT enter above $275 at the open — the Anthropic unrealized gain in GAAP EPS ($53.4B) may attract technical sellers once the headline dust settles; entry discipline protects against buying into concentrated institutional exits. Size 4% (medium conviction: earnings are confirmed but stop is wider to absorb ECI binary).
stop_loss: $240 daily close — represents a full unwind of the Q2 earnings gap reaction and return to the pre-print $231–245 trading range. A close at $240 implies one of: (1) the ECI printed ≥1.1% QoQ and September hike probability has jumped above 70%, compressing high-multiple growth equities across the board (AWS's 37% is real but the rate environment has re-priced duration risk); (2) AMZN's operating income narrative ($27.5B, ~$110B annualized) is being questioned as analysts strip the $53.4B Anthropic unrealized gain from GAAP EPS — a re-read of the quality as lower than it appears; or (3) a macro development (full Hormuz closure, direct US-Iran military conflict) triggers a risk-off event unrelated to AWS's fundamentals. Below $240 the earnings inflection is fully reversed and the position exits.
targets: $292 — quick re-rating; AWS 37% Q2 is absorbed into consensus and sell-side upgrades raise price targets to $295–310; initial institutional rebalancing into AMZN from MSFT and NVDA completes; +9.0% from $268 current price; cover 35% of position within 2–4 weeks

$320 — base case; AMZN releases Q3 AWS guidance above $45B on the Q2 call (confirming acceleration from $42.2B), or AWS margin expands above 40% (vs implied ~38% in Q2 at $27.5B operating income / $68B total AMZN revenue); sell-side consensus shifts to $300–315 price target range; +19.4% from current; cover 40% within 6–8 weeks

$355 — blue-sky; AWS AI inference run rate exceeds $30B annually (vs current >$25B implied), Anthropic partnership drives enterprise LLM deal flow that is explicitly attributed to AWS in Q3 commentary; AMZN officially positions AWS as the Anthropic primary inference layer — making the $53.4B Anthropic investment an operating-model synergy not just an unrealized gain; full multiple re-rating to 38x forward on $9.50+ FY2027 EPS estimate; hold final 25%
risk_reward: 1:1.6 to T1 / 1:3.6 to T2 / 1:8.2 to T3 from $268 entry, $240 stop
catalyst: Amazon Q2 2026 earnings (released July 30 AH): AWS grew 37% YoY to $42.2 billion — the fastest quarterly growth rate in 18 quarters — and both the AI business and custom chip business each exceeded $25 billion in annual run rates. This is not a continuation of existing momentum; it is a step-function acceleration that two independent cloud platforms (MSFT Azure 43%, AMZN AWS 37%) confirmed simultaneously in the same earnings week. Operating income of $27.5 billion Q2 (estimated 38–39% AWS margin) confirms that AI workload demand is translating into margin-accretive revenue, not just top-line. The Anthropic unrealized gain of $53.4B in GAAP EPS is the embedded option value of the leading LLM platform. Q2 EPS $5.75 (GAAP) vs $4.22 consensus.
thesis:
The distinction between this entry and the prior long-AMZN defensive thesis is what has been confirmed versus what was hypothesized. At $232 on July 3, the thesis relied on the hypothesis that AWS would accelerate from 28% Q1 growth and that rate cuts would provide multiple support. Both premises are now facts on the tape: AWS grew 37% (well above any analyst estimate), and the operating income story ($27.5B Q2) confirms that AI workloads are margin-accretive, not margin-dilutive. This entry is not 'buying the same thesis at a higher price' — it is entering a confirmed earnings upcycle at the first opportunity after confirmation.

The AWS 37% growth rate in isolation would justify an upgrade. Combined with MSFT Azure 43% from the prior session, two major cloud platforms are saying the same thing: enterprise AI workloads are not plateauing. They are accelerating. The counter-party to this read — that the two beats are a coincidence of timing and will mean-revert to 25–28% — must now contend with the fact that AWS Q2 at $42.2B and Azure Q4 at >$100B run rate are on the tape. These are not analyst forecasts; they are reported numbers.

The AI and chip businesses each exceeding $25B annual run rates are the structural signals within the AWS beat. Amazon's custom chip business — Trainium and Inferentia — is generating $25B+ annually before NVIDIA's H100/B200 competition for inference dominates. This means Amazon is capturing AI compute economics both at the AWS hyperscaler layer (renting NVIDIA and custom silicon to AI customers) and at the silicon layer (providing Trainium/Inferentia as the cost-competitive alternative). The embedded optionality on the Anthropic partnership ($53.4B unrealized on the balance sheet) becomes operational leverage, not just a financial investment, if AWS becomes Anthropic's primary inference provider.

The stop at $240 is deliberately wider than typical for a 4% position because the rate environment is the primary risk. The 30Y at 5.23% — already at a 19-year high entering July 31's ECI print — creates valuation headwind that is real and could temporarily overwhelm the earnings catalyst. The $240 stop is placed below the pre-earnings trading range to absorb a rate-spike scenario without exiting a structurally sound earnings inflection position. This represents a $28 risk from the $268 current price — manageable at 4% position size.
bull_case: ECI prints ≤0.8% QoQ on July 31 at 8:30 AM ET: September hike probability falls below 50%, 30Y retreats toward 5.00–5.10%, and AMZN's gap-up receives a rate-tailwind amplifier. Q3 AWS guidance on the Q2 call exceeds $45B. Anthropic announces a major enterprise deal explicitly citing AWS as the primary inference layer. AMZN closes July 31 at $278+, the Anthropic embedded option begins being priced into the multiple, and the stock reaches $320 (T2) by mid-September as the AI cloud upcycle becomes the consensus narrative.
bear_case: ECI prints ≥1.1% QoQ: September hike probability jumps above 70%, 30Y extends toward 5.30–5.35% (bear case from morning briefing), and every high-multiple growth stock re-prices lower. AMZN's 37% AWS beat cannot overcome a rate-spike of that magnitude in a single session — the gap pulls back toward $252–258 and pressure builds toward the $240 stop. Additionally, if investors focus on the GAAP EPS distortion ($53.4B Anthropic unrealized gain = ~$5.30 of the $5.75 EPS), they may re-price the stock as a financial investment vehicle rather than an operating business, accelerating the pullback. Stop at $240 protects the full position.
invalidation: AMZN daily close below $240 (full unwind of the earnings gap; rate headwind has overwhelmed the fundamental catalyst); OR Q3 AWS guidance below $42B on the Q2 earnings call (sequential deceleration from Q2's $42.2B — implies the 37% was driven by non-recurring workload migrations rather than structural AI demand acceleration); OR the ECI prints ≥1.2% QoQ (September hike probability above 75% — near-term rate headwind too acute to hold a high-multiple position); OR a macro Black Swan (Hormuz full closure, direct US–Iran conflict) triggers systematic risk-off forcing growth position liquidation.
